# exandra v1.1.0 - Table of Contents

Exandra is an Elixir library that brings the power of Scylla/Cassandra to Ecto.

## Modules

- [Exandra](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.md): Adapter module for [Apache Cassandra](https://cassandra.apache.org/_/index.html)
and [ScyllaDB](https://www.scylladb.com/).
- [Exandra.Batch](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.Batch.md): A struct that represents a batch of queries to be executed in a single
request to Cassandra/Scylla.
- [Exandra.EmbeddedType](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.EmbeddedType.md): `Ecto.ParameterizedType` for **User-Defined Types** (UDTs) with Ecto.Schemas.

- Ecto types
  - [Exandra.Counter](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.Counter.md): `Ecto.Type` for counters.
  - [Exandra.Inet](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.Inet.md): `Ecto.Type` for inets.
  - [Exandra.Map](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.Map.md): `Ecto.ParameterizedType` for maps.
  - [Exandra.Set](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.Set.md): `Ecto.ParameterizedType` for sets.
  - [Exandra.Tuple](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.Tuple.md): `Ecto.ParameterizedType` for tuples.
  - [Exandra.UDT](https://exandra.hexdocs.pm/Exandra.UDT.md): `Ecto.ParameterizedType` for **User-Defined Types** (UDTs).
